verdict.rationale: Elastic markets an AI SRE (nightshift) that detects and investigates incidents and delivers evidence-backed root cause, plus natural-language interaction with telemetry. That is close to AI-generated incident context, but the evidence never explicitly describes summaries of incidents or alerts written for responders. Missing for 10: explicit AI-generated incident/alert summary feature documentation, integration of summaries into alerts/Cases for responders, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated summaries of incidents and alert context for responders

citations.quote: Elastic nightshift AI SRE detects and investigates incidents, delivering evidence-backed root cause.
Interact directly with your telemetry through natural language and resolve problems faster without switching tabs or context.
